request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. Movement II: 148 BPM. Bronze bells, forge metal, celesta, broken strings, low horns, snare and wordless treble choir enter in clear stages. Present original, augmented and diminished Silent Toll motifs simultaneously in transparent counterpoint; whole-tone tide clusters rise beneath. Highest plucked strings carry Crimson Thread. Immense emotional pressure, controlled headroom, no wall of noise. Only wordless humming or vowel choir as specified; NO intelligible words, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
